notice.en: Banco Andino is a synthetic bank. Its balance-sheet aggregates are calibrated to the CMF system aggregates of August 2026; the UF share, the repricing profile of each item, the deposit split and every behavioural assumption are synthetic and stated in the document. The curves are real: the Banco Central de Chile F022 yields of the valuation date.
notice.es: Banco Andino es un banco sintético. Los agregados de su balance están calibrados a los agregados del sistema de la CMF de agosto de 2026; la proporción en UF, el perfil de reprecio de cada partida, la separación de depósitos y todo supuesto de comportamiento son sintéticos y están declarados en el documento. Las curvas son reales: los rendimientos F022 del Banco Central de Chile de la fecha de valoración.

margin_volatility_reason.en: The synthetic bank has no history of client rates to estimate the margin of the replicating portfolio from; the portfolio is a stated synthetic assumption. It is built from the requested core maturity, which stands above the Table 4 cap for retail-operational and wholesale deposits: the standardised treatment of the variant documents uses the capped values (core_share_used and core_maturity_used_years of nmd_segments), not these weights.
margin_volatility_reason.es: El banco sintético no tiene historia de tasas a clientes para estimar el margen de la cartera replicante; la cartera es un supuesto sintético declarado. Se construye con el plazo estable solicitado, que supera el tope de la Tabla 4 en los depósitos retail operacionales y mayoristas: el tratamiento estándar de los documentos de variante usa los valores con tope (core_share_used y core_maturity_used_years de nmd_segments), no estos pesos.

deposit_beta.source: Stated by Contraste (synthetic): one pass-through of the short rate to the rate paid on non-maturity deposits, used by the dynamic NII. No deposit-rate history exists for a synthetic bank, so no beta is fitted.

prepayment.source: Stated by Contraste (synthetic): the CMF aggregates carry no prepayment history. The residential mortgage items carry the prepayable-loan class; the SRP31.119 multipliers are tabled in the models document and, as in C14, not applied per shock (the definition of the outstanding notional of SRP31.121 is UNVERIFIED in the engine contract).
